messages.subject: Re: how to change both line type and color type simultaneously? (I have problem in line type change)
parts:
On 2/14/2013 1:40 PM, Sophia wrote:
> Dear ggplot2 users,
>
> I have problem in changing line type and color type simultaneously. I have
> succeeded in color change but not line type change.
> Here is an example. The line types do not change.
>
> df2 <- read.table(header=T, text='
> cond1 cond2 yval
> A I 2
> A J 2.5
> A K 1.6
> B I 2.2
> B J 2.4
> B K 1.2
> C I 1.7
> C J 2.3
> C K 1.9
> ')
>
> qplot(cond1, yval, data = df2, colour = cond2) +
> geom_line(aes(group = cond2), ylim = c(0,1)) +
> scale_linetype_manual(values=c(2,3,1)) +
> scale_color_manual(values= c("#377EB8", "#E41A1C", "#4DAF4A"))

You never set the linetype aesthetic:

qplot(cond1, yval, data = df2, colour = cond2) +
geom_line(aes(group = cond2, linetype = cond2), ylim = c(0,1)) +
scale_linetype_manual(values=c(2,3,1)) +
scale_color_manual(values= c("#377EB8", "#E41A1C", "#4DAF4A"))

> Thank you for your help!
>
